std::cout se terminal me Grade: A display hua.

cpp_swap_temp.learningObjective: Understand variable value swapping using a third temporary memory slot in C++.

executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Variable a (10) [4 Bytes] memory me allocate hua.
Variable b (20) [4 Bytes] memory me allocate hua.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: int temp = a (10). Copy value of a to temp.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: temp variable me a ki value (10) store ki.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: a = b (20). Assign value of b into a.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: b (20) ki value a me copy hui (a changed from 10 -> 20).

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: b = temp (10). Assign value of temp into b. Swapping finished!
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: temp (10) ki value b me store hui -> b = 10. Swapping Complete!

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: cout prints swapped values a: 20, b: 10.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Console par Swapped values display hui: a: 20, b: 10.

cpp_swap_no_temp.learningObjective: Swap two variables using arithmetic addition and subtraction.

executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Variable a (5) [4 Bytes] memory me allocate hua.
Variable b (15) [4 Bytes] memory me allocate hua.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: a = a + b -> 5 + 15 = 20. Calculate sum of both variables.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: a = a + b (5 + 15 = 20). a me dono variables ka total sum store hua -> 20.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: b = a - b -> 20 - 15 = 5. Extract original a value into b.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: b = a - b (20 - 15 = 5). b me original a ki value (5) aagayi.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: a = a - b -> 20 - 5 = 15. Extract original b value into a. Swapping Complete!
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: a = a - b (20 - 5 = 15). a me original b ki value (15) aagayi. Swapping Complete!

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: cout prints swapped values a: 15, b: 5.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Console par Swapped values display hui: a: 15, b: 5.

cpp_largest_three.learningObjective: Use nested if-else with logical AND to find the greatest among three integers.

executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Pehla variable a = 12 [int] memory me store hua.
Doosra variable b = 45 [int] memory me store hua.
Teesra variable c = 29 [int] memory me store hua.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Check if a >= b && a >= c → 12 >= 45 && 12 >= 29 → false.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: 1st if condition: a>=45 AND a>=29 → false (agla condition check hoga).
else-if condition: b>=29 → true (b sabse bada hai).
cout output: "Largest = 45" terminal par print hua.

cpp_leap_year.learningObjective: Evaluate divisibility by 4, 100, 400 to determine if a year is a leap year.

executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Variable year = 2024 [4B int] memory me store hua.
Pehla part: year%4==0 AND year%100!=0 → (true AND true) → true.
Doosra part: year%400==0 → false. Pura condition: true (Leap Year hai).

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: cout prints: 2024 is a Leap Year.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: cout output: "2024 is a Leap Year" terminal par print hua.

cpp_marks_grade.learningObjective: Assign letter grades using a multi-tier if-else-if ladder based on marks.

executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Variable marks = 85 [4B] memory me store hua.
if (marks >= 90): 85 >= 90 → false → agla check.
else if (marks >= 80): 85 >= 80 → true → Grade A.
cout output: "Grade: A" terminal par print hua.

cpp_tax_calc.learningObjective: Calculate income tax using tiered slab rates with if-else-if ladder.

executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Variable income = 600000 [int] memory me store hua.
Double variable tax = 0.00 [double] initialize hua.
1st Slab check: 600000 <= 250000 → false (agla slab check होगा).
2nd Slab check: 600000 <= 500000 → false (agla slab check होगा).
3rd Slab check: 600000 <= 1000000 → true (20% Slab apply hoga).
cout output: "Tax = 32500.00" terminal par print hua.

cpp_pos_neg_zero.learningObjective: Classify an integer as positive, negative, or zero using if-else-if.

executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Variable n = -15 [4B] memory me store hua.
if (n > 0): -15 > 0 → false → agla check.
else if (n < 0): -15 < 0 → true → Negative hai.
cout output: "-15 is Negative" terminal par print hua.

cpp_electricity_bill.learningObjective: Calculate monthly electricity bill using tiered unit slabs with if-else-if.

executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Variable units = 250 [4B] memory me store hua.
if (units <= 100): false → agla slab check.
else if (units <= 200): false → 6.50/unit slab.
Slab formula apply hokar bill = Rs. 1175.00 calculate hua.
cout output: "Bill = 1175.00" terminal par print hua.
